themes_detail.label: Parks Overuse Crisis Erupting
themes_detail.summary: Park rules violations spiked to 4 complaints this week versus 0.1 weekly average—a 3100% increase (z-score: 11.72)—suggesting potential overcrowding, unsafe conditions, or organized activity in East Harlem parks that has emerged suddenly.
evidence: 4 park rules violation complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (z-score: 11.72)
Statistically significant spike indicates acute rather than chronic issue
Park-related budget requests from CB suggest longstanding access/maintenance issues may have created conditions for current spike
reporting_angles: What specific parks are affected and what rule violations are being reported? (Visit parks this week, interview Parks Dept)
Is this tied to warmer weather, a specific event, or new homeless encampments in parks? (Cross-reference with encampment and drug activity spikes)

themes_detail.label: Sanitation Breakdown: Dead Animals & Litter
themes_detail.summary: Two sanitation crises converged this week: dead animal complaints hit 3 (up 1100% from 0.2 weekly average) and litter basket requests jumped to 3 (up 2300% from 0.1 average), signaling potential public health and waste management failures.
evidence: 3 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 6.35)
3 litter basket requests THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 8.69)
Community board has requested graffiti removal/cleaning increases for years—underlying sanitation issues may be cascading
reporting_angles: Which neighborhoods in CD111 are reporting dead animals and where are litter baskets missing? (FOIL 311 addresses, photo canvass)
Is DSNY response time degraded or is this tied to the broader homeless/encampment surge this week?

themes_detail.label: Vehicle Noise Surge & Street Disorder
themes_detail.summary: Vehicle noise complaints spiked to 26 this week—a 247% increase over the 7.5 weekly average (z-score: 5.13)—coinciding with a 554% spike in encampment complaints (9 this week vs 1.4 avg), suggesting possible street takeovers, illegal activity clustering, or transport/delivery disruptions.
evidence: 26 vehicle noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.5 weekly average (z-score: 5.13)
9 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (z-score: 6.26)
Community board has requested additional traffic enforcement agents—enforcement gaps may be enabling current surge
reporting_angles: Are illegal street takeovers, modified vehicles, or late-night delivery trucks concentrated on specific corridors? (Map 311 complaints by address, visit hotspots)
Are new encampments tied to vehicle noise or vice versa—is one triggering displacement and disorder?

themes_detail.label: Encampment & Drug Crisis Accelerating
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints surged to 9 this week (554% above 1.4 weekly average), while drug activity complaints peaked 2 weeks ago at 9 (324% above 2.1 weekly average), indicating a sustained public safety and homelessness crisis that is currently acute.
evidence: 9 encampment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average (z-score: 6.26)
9 drug activity complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 2.1 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)
Convergence with food poisoning spike (3 last week vs 0.4 avg, z-score: 5.42) suggests unsanitary conditions in encampment areas
reporting_angles: Where are encampments concentrated and how has their size/density changed in past 2 weeks? (DSNY, NYPD, outreach partner interviews)
What services or interventions are available and why are they insufficient? (Interview HRA, DHS, local nonprofits)

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Spike in District
themes_detail.summary: Food poisoning complaints jumped to 3 last week—a 700% increase from 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)—signaling potential restaurant or vendor health code violations that require immediate investigation.
evidence: 3 food poisoning complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)
Spike is recent but not current—warrants urgent follow-up to determine if outbreak is ongoing
May be linked to encampment-area food handling or informal food service operations
reporting_angles: Which restaurants, food carts, or vendors are the complaints tied to? (FOIL 311 complaint details, cross-check with DOHMH inspection records)
Is this an outbreak cluster or dispersed complaints? Have any establishments been shut down or cited this week?
